tools.name: ngm_query_judicial
tools.description:
Search judicial cases from Nepal's court system. Execute SELECT queries against NGM court and court case tables. By default, we should fetch only a few results (e.g. 5) to avoid eating up the context window.

Table Schemas:
- courts: identifier (PK), court_type, full_name_nepali, full_name_english, created_at, updated_at
- court_cases: case_number (PK), court_identifier (PK), registration_date_bs, registration_date_ad, case_type, division, category, section, plaintiff, defendant, original_case_number, case_id, priority, registration_number, case_status, verdict_date_bs, verdict_date_ad, verdict_judge, status, extra_data
- court_case_hearings: id (PK), case_number, court_identifier, hearing_date_bs, hearing_date_ad, bench, bench_type, judge_names, lawyer_names, serial_no, case_status, decision_type, remarks, extra_data
- court_case_entities: id (PK), case_number, court_identifier, side, name, address, nes_id

Court IDs (court_identifier):
- Supreme & Special: supreme, special
- High Courts: biratnagarhc, illamhc, dhankutahc, okhaldhungahc, janakpurhc, rajbirajhc, birganjhc, patanhc, hetaudahc, pokharahc, baglunghc, tulsipurhc, butwalhc, nepalgunjhc, surkhethc, jumlahc, dipayalhc, mahendranagarhc
- District Courts: achhamdc, argakhanchidc, etc.

query.description: SQL SELECT query to execute. Must be read-only. By default, we should fetch only a few results (e.g. 5) to avoid eating up the context window.

tools.name: ngm_extract_case_data
tools.description:
Extract complete judicial case information from Nepal's court system (NGM database) into a Markdown file.
This includes case metadata, hearings, and entities (plaintiffs/defendants).

Court IDs (court_identifier):
- Supreme & Special: supreme, special
- High Courts: biratnagarhc, illamhc, dhankutahc, okhaldhungahc, janakpurhc, rajbirajhc, birganjhc, patanhc, hetaudahc, pokharahc, baglunghc, tulsipurhc, butwalhc, nepalgunjhc, surkhethc, jumlahc, dipayalhc, mahendranagarhc
- District Courts: achhamdc, argakhanchidc, etc.

court_identifier.description: Identifier for the court (e.g. supreme, patanhc, special)

case_number.description: The exact case number to extract data for

file_path.description: Absolute path to save the generated Markdown document

tools.name: search_jawafdehi_cases
tools.description: Search for published Jawafdehi accountability cases (corruption) by typing keywords or tags.

search.description: Full-text search across title, description, and key allegations.

tags.description: Filter cases containing a specific tag.

tools.name: get_jawafdehi_case
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific published Jawafdehi case, including its allegations, evidence, timeline, and audit history.

case_id.description: A unique integer value identifying the case.

fetch_sources.description: If true, the tool will also fetch detailed information for each source referenced in the case.

tools.name: create_jawafdehi_case
tools.description: Create a draft Jawafdehi case using a simple authenticated interface. Requires JAWAFDEHI_API_TOKEN.

tools.name: patch_jawafdehi_case
tools.description: Patch a Jawafdehi case using raw RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations. Requires JAWAFDEHI_API_TOKEN.

case_id.description: Database id of the case to patch.

tools.name: submit_nes_change
tools.description: Submit a Jawafdehi NES queue change request for one of the supported actions: ADD_NAME, CREATE_ENTITY, or UPDATE_ENTITY.

payload.description: Action-specific payload accepted by Jawafdehi NESQ.

change_description.description: Human-readable summary of the requested change.

auto_approve.description: Optional privileged flag to request immediate approval. The API enforces permission checks.

tools.name: search_nes_entities
tools.description: Search for Nepal Entity Service (NES) entities using various filters.

entity_type.description: Filter by primary entity type (e.g., person, organization, location).

query.description: Text query to search in entity names (e.g., 'poudel').

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to filter by (uses AND logic, e.g., 'politician,senior-leader').

offset.description: Number of results to skip (default is 0).

tools.name: get_nes_entities
tools.description: Retrieve the complete profiles of one or more NES entities by their unique IDs.

entity_ids.description: A list of unique entity identifiers to retrieve (e.g., ['entity:person/ram-chandra-poudel']).

tools.name: get_nes_entity_prefixes
tools.description: Fetch the available NES entity prefixes and related metadata.

tools.name: get_nes_entity_prefix_schema
tools.description: Fetch the JSON schema for a specific NES entity prefix.

tools.name: get_nes_tags
tools.description: Fetch the complete list of all unique entity tag values present in the NES database.

tools.name: convert_date
tools.description: Convert dates between AD (Gregorian) and BS (Bikram Sambat). Works in the Asia/Kathmandu time zone. Often times, LLMs convert date wrongly and this tool will provide the correct conversion.

dates.description: A list of dates to convert in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. ['2023-01-15', '2079-10-01']).

mode.description: The direction of the conversion ('ad_to_bs' or 'bs_to_ad').

tools.name: convert_to_markdown
tools.description:
Convert documents to Markdown with smart auto-detection. Automatically chooses the best conversion method:

**Likhit (for local PDF files):**
- Used automatically for local `.pdf` files
- Better Nepali/Kalimati text handling for supported documents
- Auto-detects supported structure from the PDF itself

**MarkItDown (for general documents):**
- Office documents: DOCX, PPTX, XLSX
- Web pages: http://, https:// URLs
- Local files via `file://` URIs and non-PDF local files
- Data URIs: data:text/plain;base64,...

**Auto-detection logic:**
1. If the source is a local PDF file → Use Likhit
2. Otherwise → Use MarkItDown based on file extension or URI scheme
3. If Likhit fails → Automatically fall back to MarkItDown

⚠️ **Important**: MarkItDown may not accurately convert Nepali text in PDFs. For Nepali PDFs, Likhit is preferred when the input is a local PDF file.

file_path.description: Absolute path to a local file. Local PDFs are processed with Likhit; other local files are converted with MarkItDown. Mutually exclusive with 'uri'.

uri.description:
URI of the resource to convert (for MarkItDown). Supports:
- file:///absolute/path/to/document
- http://example.com/document
- https://example.com/document
- data:text/plain;base64,...
Mutually exclusive with 'file_path'.

output_path.description: Optional. Absolute path to write the converted Markdown file. Parent directories are created automatically.

enable_plugins.description: Optional. Enable MarkItDown plugins (MarkItDown only). Defaults to False. Only used when using MarkItDown converter.
